scope: Real team simulation, boundary saves and simultaneous trades; explicit DOM/Canvas adapter, not native browser

checks.name: Malformed winner phases are rejected atomically instead of throwing while drawing
A corrupted orphan lock cannot silently immobilize an active or reserve member
Malformed placed objects cannot produce NaN coordinates or a missing-anchor crash after resume
Valid tag checkpoints preserve their lock before and after transfer
AI respects the same tag commitment as a player and cannot inject a dash
An equal-frame final trade awards control and the finisher to the living reserve on either side
